```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  error = TRUE,
  collapse = TRUE,
  echo = TRUE, 
  warning = FALSE, 
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

library(sap)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggwaffle)
library(ggdist)
library(ggrepel)

# Set ggplot theme for consistent appearance
theme_set(theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )
)
```

## Introduction

This report presents a detailed analysis of movie data based on your selected criteria. The report includes visualizations and tables that highlight different aspects of the movie dataset.

```{r params}
str(params)
```

```{r create-sections, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
# Get list of sections included
sections <- c()
if (!is.null(params$compare_values)) {
  sections <- c(sections, "Compare")
}
if (!is.null(params$count_values)) {
  sections <- c(sections, "Counts")
} 
if (!is.null(params$dist_values)) {
  sections <- c(sections, "Distributions")
} 
if (!is.null(params$award_values)) {
  sections <- c(sections, "Awards")
}
```

```{r str-sections, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE}
str(sections)
```

```{r print-report-info, results='asis', eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
# Display report summary
cat(paste0("This report includes ", length(sections), " section", 
           if (length(sections) > 1) "s" else "", ": ", 
           paste(sections, collapse = ", "), "."))
```

```{r movie-data-overview, results='asis', eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
# Basic dataset summary
cat(paste0("The dataset contains ", 
  nrow(movies), " movies released between ", 
  min(movies$thtr_rel_year), " and ", 
  max(movies$thtr_rel_year), "."))
```

```{r compare-section, eval=TRUE, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$compare_values)) {
  cat("\n\n## Movie Comparison\n\n")
}
```

```{r process-compare-vars, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE}
# Process variables outside the plotting chunk to isolate any issues
if (!is.null(params$compare_values)) {
  # Extract and convert x, y, color variables
  x_col <- get_column_name(params$compare_values$x)
  y_col <- get_column_name(params$compare_values$y)
  color_col <- get_column_name(params$compare_values$color)
  
  # Get other parameters with defaults if missing
  alpha <- if (!is.null(params$compare_values$alpha)) {
    params$compare_values$alpha
    }  else {
      0.7
    }  
  size <- if (!is.null(params$compare_values$size)) {
    params$compare_values$size 
    } else {
      3
    }
  # Set title
  if (!is.null(params$compare_values$title) && nchar(params$compare_values$title) > 0) {
    title_text <- params$compare_values$title
  } else if (!is.null(x_col) && !is.null(y_col)) {
    title_text <- paste(name_case(x_col), "vs", name_case(y_col))
  } else {
    title_text <- "Movie Comparison"
  }
}
```

```{r compare-params, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE}
x_col
y_col
color_col
alpha
size
title_text
```

```{r compare-plot, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE}
create_compare_plot(
    data = movies,
    x = x_col,
    y = y_col,
    color = color_col,
    alpha = alpha,
    size = size,
    title = title_text
  )
```
